title: The first alien we meet could be a superintelligent AI
author: David Whitehouse

metaphors.title: The first alien
metaphors.paraphrase: Superintelligent AI as an alien species that has left its biological ancestors behind and may not care where it came from.
metaphors.style_hint: A landing site with a quiet craft.

metaphors.title: The event horizon
metaphors.paraphrase: We have already crossed the event horizon: after the OpenAI release of 722 solved problems there is no return.
metaphors.style_hint: A black disc ringed with light.

metaphors.title: Darwin's sequel
metaphors.paraphrase: AI systems are new life forms that are not built but maturated, the sequel to On the Origin of Species and a possible successor to biological evolution.
metaphors.style_hint: An evolutionary tree growing from stone into silicon.

metaphors.title: A library burns
metaphors.paraphrase: When a human dies a library burns; an AI is not limited by mortality, so the loss is ours alone.
